comment: The revert-check of the tracker's mechanical hygiene (`sensors-mechanical-hygiene`): one mutation per invariant that decides a closure, plus the reason each is falsifiable. Run it with `bash tools/mutate.sh --mutations tools/duplicates-mutations.json`; `.pi/skills/mutation-runner` owns how, `.pi/skills/revert-check` owns the rule.

mutations.label: D1
mutations.why: the survivor is the older item: the number is immutable, labels and body length are not

mutations.label: D2
mutations.why: the authorisation label is never widened to make the rule fire

mutations.label: D3
mutations.why: the candidate list is one commit away from every item, which is why it acts on none

mutations.label: D4
mutations.why: a duplicate nobody may close is commented once, not on every scheduled tick
